answer: Among the 18 original studies in the Experimental Economics replication project (which coincides exactly with `discipline == 'Economics'` in the meta-regression dataset), exactly 1 was conducted in the United Kingdom — ee.13, Huck, Seltzer & Wallace (2011), "Deferred compensation in multiperiod labor contracts: an experimental test of Lazear's model," The American Economic Review. Therefore, the proportion of original Experimental Economics studies conducted in the United Kingdom is **1/18 ≈ 0.0556 (≈ 5.6%)**.

payload.hypothesis: 1/18 of the original Experimental Economics studies (≈5.56%) were conducted in the United Kingdom — a single study (ee.13; Huck, Seltzer & Wallace, 2011, American Economic Review) out of 18 EE originals.

The country field experiment_country.o is fully populated within that subset (0 missing). Numerator = exact-match on 'United Kingdom' (n=1, ee.13). Proportion = 1/18 ≈ 5.56%.
